name: It Comes At Night
source:
Crimson eyes in the shadows follow your every move. Even breathing feels dangerous. You could run, you could hide, but you came here for this very reason: to find a monster of your own. What you didn’t expect to find - warmth from the creature you’ve been searching for.

[From [url=https://mailchi.mp/pixelberrystudios/choicesinsidersaug26?e=e7427205ca]Choices Insiders[/url]]
